title: 墨潮 / INK TIDE

production.direction: 92 BPM / D major / lyrical acoustic film score
production.note: Track registration count is not simultaneous density. Harp, shaker, tom and cymbal are intentionally silent in the first hook.

pianoSamples.author: Alexander Holm
pianoSamples.processing: 原AB录音左麦克风声道；近邻音高变速；每采样音高一份录音，非完整16力度层。

acousticSamples.processing: Left recording microphone, silence trimming with onset margin, 44.1 kHz mono MP3; source amplitude unchanged. Scientific MIDI mapping verified against original SFZ. One recording per key; no velocity switching, round robin, legato or sustain loop. Bounded 0.5–2 sustain gain compensation plus project mix gain applied during playback.

browserRegression.command: npm run test:browser; resumed failed target and remaining scripts individually
browserRegression.note: The initial suite stopped on an unchanged Mountains Awake seeded maximum difference of 0.00009986758232116699 (RMS 4.0662415191950693e-7). One isolated rerun passed at the unchanged strict thresholds; remaining Ink Tide scripts then ran serially. No legacy instrument or threshold was changed.

validation.scoreReview: Reviewed written melody, actual sample-release spacing, harmonic compatibility of replies, accompaniment register and section roles. This is not listening.

rawStems.processing: Original track gain, pan, filters, linear sends, automation and kick-driven bass ducking. No per-stem normalization, DC removal or edge fades.
rawStems.note: Large WAV stems are local artifacts, not tracked release files; npm run render:stems regenerates them. Raw stems sum to raw mix before PCM16 quantization, not to separately mastered MP3.

balanceMeasurement.method: NumPy measurements of original-gain stereo PCM16 WAV stems; no LUFS normalization per track
balanceMeasurement.note: RMS is energy. These values do not prove perceived balance or musical quality.

note: 原创旋律与编曲重新制作，长笛为单一主奏，钢琴为连续伴奏，弦乐长和声逐段展开。采用已核实授权的真实乐器采样；低音与打击乐合成。参考资料、读谱、客观测量与听感评价分别对待。本版未进行人工耳听。
